types.description: Green flush spring-return illuminated pushbutton head, 22 mm, metal bezel; mechanical head only

modelingNotes: Historical Schneider catalog prints ZB4-BW333; the 2021 catalog prints ZB4BW333 for the matching green flush integral-LED-compatible head. Exact historical order spelling is retained.

Mechanical head only, plain unmarked lens and spring return. Associated body, light block and contact blocks are separate; composition diagrams specify possible assemblies, not populated head terminals.

No electrical terminals or fixed links documented. Class I is stated in the product sheet, but a head bonding terminal or attachment continuity is not established. Do not infer a PE path through metalwork or panel mounting.
Documentation accessory view; no electrical functions or assigned voltage/current ratings. No assembly contacts or lamp connections are transferred to this head.

connectionCoverage.notes: Zero documented electrical terminals for the mechanical head. No included contact or LED block. The metal head/collar/panel bonding and attachment interface remains undocumented; an exhaustive empty physical connection inventory and installed bonding continuity are not asserted.
